Latin word

vērō

adverb, usually after the first word

indeed, truly (stressing the statement); indeed, truly; yes indeed

In this lexicon

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Ph. 1053–1054: Mē ad cēnam vocā. — Pol vērō vocō.; Cic. Fam. 14.4.1: ego vērō tē quam prīmum, mea vīta, cupiō vidēre

  • truly

    also used · classical · Traupman 332

  • minimē vērō: no

    classical
